title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Sunday, 15 November 2026
description: Nvidia's board continues its independent review involving CEO Jensen Huang, Australia's unemployment rate holds steady at 4.6 per cent, Queensland hosts today's Rugby League World Cup final at Suncorp Stadium, and the Gold Coast wraps up the Pan Pacific Masters Games. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
